need.title: Community Garden Bed Wait List - Lottery Nov 2
need.details: Good Afternoon Beachwalk, If you are interested in a garden bed plot, please email Megan Heins at mheins@castlegroup.com . Our guidelines have been revised and have been attached for your review. We will be hosting a live "lottery" via zoom on Monday November 2nd at 1:00PM for those who are interested in a bed assignment. Please be advised that spots for the garden are limited. If you are interested please reach out to Megan no later than 9am on Monday November 2nd to add your name to the list. Thank you and have a wonderful day! Attachment: 26-10-16 Garden Bed Guidelines UPDATED v4.pdf

need.title: Election & Annual Meeting - Nov 4
need.details: Good Afternoon Beachwalk, Board of Director’s Election Proxy & Voting Certificates: Proxy is for quorum only. Beachwalk has 1,623 lots. Need 30% or 487 residents to attend in person or by proxy. Submit proxy via pink envelope or electronically on Get Quorum (emailed Oct 12; contact mheins@castlegroup.com if missing). Voting Certificate only if multi-owner, corp, trust, LLC etc. Paper ballots require date, lot #, address, print name, owner signature (only one needed). Only one vote per household. Secret election – only ballot in small envelope. Annual Meeting Nov 4 at 11am at Elks Lodge Englewood, check-in 10am. Contact Megan Heins mheins@castlegroup.com for questions.
